feature: Explicit agent audio sharing: Pi audio reel, durable archive, ag audio, merged ag sync and the dash Audio tab
direction: Same quiet ag theme: a dense clip list (title, node/agent provenance, duration, format) with a docked transport. In the terminal, a two-line now-playing widget and a bottom-docked overlay with click/keyboard transport. Explicit shares only; speech never enters this pathway.

requirements.contract: audio_share accepts exactly one of a file path or base64 data (data: URLs included). Encoded files are content-sniffed (WAV, MP3, OGG/Opus, FLAC, M4A/AAC, WebM/Matroska, AIFF, MIDI); raw PCM (s16le/s24le/s32le/f32le/u8, 1–8 channels) is wrapped as WAV. Nothing autoplays unless play=true.

Unless PI_INCOGNITO=1 or PI_SHARED_AUDIO_ENABLED=0, shares are copied to $XDG_STATE_HOME/agent-utils/audio/<agent>/aud-<id>.<ext> (PI_SHARED_AUDIO_DIR overrides) with an atomically published owner-private sidecar as commit marker, idempotent per share event, recording title/description/duration/rate/channels when known. TTS, narration, read-aloud and choice audio are never captured.

The session reel persists through tool-result details and custom entries, restores the active branch's latest snapshot, prefers surviving archive copies and prunes clips missing from disk. The passive widget shows status, progress and the reel; /audio-reel opens an overlay controllable by keyboard and SGR mouse (buttons, seek bar, list, wheel) whose lines always fit the terminal.

One owned decoder→sink pipeline: PCM16 WAV streams natively (no ffmpeg); other formats decode with ffmpeg (file: protocol pinned). Pulse (pacat) by default honouring PULSE_SERVER/PULSE_SINK; PI_AUDIO_BACKEND/SERVER/SINK, /audio-output and per-play overrides select pulse, sox or ffplay. Pause/seek/volume restart at the tracked position; decoder or sink failures surface their stderr; kills are reaped. Never touches speech mute policy, the speech queue or default sinks.

ag audio [view|pull|list|info|get|play] mirrors ag image over the audio archive: incremental rsync cache under ~/.cache/ag/audio (gallery.audio_cache_dir, --cache-dir), sidecar + SHA-256 + audio/* validation, offline reads, private HTML player with filters/search/keyboard and unsupported-format notes. ag audio play prefers a verified cached copy, otherwise fetches from one --host, and plays through the same backends; CLI only.

ag sync (and ag_sync) pulls every media pathway concurrently under one parallelism budget (--images/--audio narrow), regenerating both viewers. A pathway failure (for example a held cache lock) is reported in errors without hiding the other; partial results exit 3. Image cache keys are unchanged so existing caches are reused.

ag dash runs the merged sync on dash.image_refresh_seconds for images and audio, with per-pathway status/busy flags, --no-audio/dash.audio and --audio-cache-dir. /audio/* serves only the generated index and archive files (no sidecars, traversal or symlink escape) behind the same cookie/Host checks, with single-range HTTP 206/416 for seeking. The Audio tab defers reloads while a clip is playing.

ag_audio_pull and ag_sync require confirmed=true; ag_audio_list/ag_audio_info are read-only and return bounded metadata, never audio bytes. Peer protocol adds ag node audio-list/audio-info/audio-read.
Home Manager services.ag-dash gains audio (default true → --no-audio when false) and audioCacheDirectory; no new service, port or activation.
